Detailed Options for Montreal Winters
Mackage Adali-BX: A flagship "Signature Fit" coat available at retailers like Holt Renfrew Ogilvy. It features an asymmetrical zip and a blue fox fur-trimmed hood. The inner bib with a rib collar provides extra protection against wind tunnel effects on Ste-Catherine Street.
Nobis She-Ra Parka: Highly technical and fully waterproof (10,000mm rating). It uses magnetic closures instead of buttons for convenience with gloves and includes a removable Rex Rabbit fur collar for a transition from casual to elegant.
Kanuk Jackets: A Montreal staple for over 50 years, known for its artisanal production. These coats are highly windproof and come with a lifetime warranty, making them a long-term investment for residents.
Moose Knuckles Gold Series Jocada: For maximum coverage, this ankle-length parka uses "Nyluxe" fabric that is soft yet durable against wind and water. It includes side snaps for mobility while walking through slush or boarding the Metro.
Quartz Co. Kimberly: A more streamlined, minimalist option that uses Repreve recycled fibers. It offers a semi-fitted silhouette that allows for layering without looking bulky.
